text.en:
After Damaging 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each:
+10 Range, 5% Increased Falloff Distance, +10 Stability, +35 Handling, +35 Reload Speed, and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier for 10 seconds.

Buff can't be refreshed.

#e Buff Duration is increased to 11 seconds.
)
